limits: Structural and shader-source checks do not compile GLSL or produce WebGL pixels.
No browser, GPU, physical device, frame time, touch, listening, photorealism or external quality comparison was validated by this work.
All-instance triangle bounds include invisible actors and hidden equipment and ignore renderer frustum/distance culling.
Near/far trees update after at least 12 metres of travel; no transition fade. High/medium radii are 80/52 metres; low uses only distant geometry.
No collision, terrain-height function, navigation, progression, save schema or tree/grass random stream changes.

Fire and memory energy retain stylized emissive geometry. No real fluid simulation, screen-space reflection/refraction, volumetric ray marching, imported photogrammetry or photorealistic asset quality is asserted.
Runtime material base payload is 524288 bytes for eight shared 128x128 RGBA fields; full mip chains would add approximately one third. No compressed texture download bytes were added.
